 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The two colors form vertical bars on either side of the blank gap,
    # repeated above and below the horizontal divider. Infer the color of
    # the complete/longer repeated bar pair and encode it as a 2x2 tile.
    divider = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row)), len(grid)//2)
    top, bottom = grid[:divider], grid[divider+1:]
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,5)})
    scores = {}
    for color in colors:
        # continuity/repetition across both panels, favoring whichever pattern
        # is more developed overall
        scores[color] = sum(cell == color for row in grid for cell in row)
    winner = max(colors, key=lambda c: scores[c])
    return [[winner, winner], [winner, winner]]
